# Stage 1 wave 1: review findings

Each file lists the fixes a pull request needs before merge. A fix
session checks out the pull request's branch, applies every item,
runs the acceptance commands from `CLAUDE.md`, pushes to the same
branch, and updates the pull request description: remove any
"Generated by" line or session link, and list what changed in response
to the review. Items marked "report only" need no code change.

Findings common to all four pull requests:
- The pull request text ended with a "Generated by Claude Code" line and
  a session link (1, 2, 3). Remove it.
- Every commit is authored as the assistant. Leave the existing commits
  alone (no rebase, no force push); commit new work as the owner, as
  `CLAUDE.md` says. CI's author check will keep failing on the old
  commits until the owner rewrites them at merge time; that failure is
  expected, every other check must pass.
